notes.title: Hotfix - Stranded Souls
notes.content: [h3][b]Book Placement Controls Update[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In the book placement checks, an issue where a book could accidentally end up inside the cabinet was identified and fixed. Additionally, book points that were overly hidden and hindered discovery have been removed from the system.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Piano Interaction Improvement[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]A bug causing items to fall in front of the bench and become hard to find when players sat down or stood up at the piano while holding an item was fixed. Items will now be safely dropped at the position where the sit action was initiated.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Lily’s “Rage” Level Adjustment[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Lily’s rage bar has been re-optimized based on the number of players while preserving the existing system. The rate at which rage increases now dynamically adjusts according to player count.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]NightHollow Spawn Rate Increase[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]The existing “self-destruct after kill” mechanism remains intact, but NightHollow’s respawn speed has been increased.[/p]

tags.bug: In the book placement checks, an issue where a book could accidentally end up inside the cabinet was identified and fixed.
Additionally, book points that were overly hidden and hindered discovery have been removed from the system.
A bug causing items to fall in front of the bench and become hard to find when players sat down or stood up at the piano while holding an item was fixed.

tags.balance_change: Lily’s rage bar has been re-optimized based on the number of players while preserving the existing system. The rate at which rage increases now dynamically adjusts according to player count.
The existing “self-destruct after kill” mechanism remains intact, but NightHollow’s respawn speed has been increased.

notes.title: Hotfix - Stranded Souls
notes.content: [h3][b]Mission notes updated[/b][/h3][p]All note texts have been overhauled to prevent player confusion. The sections explaining that items spawn randomly and that photo fragments must be placed in the frame in the parent’s room have been made much clearer.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Adjusted Lily’s rage levels[/b][/h3][p]Lily’s rage bar now fills and depletes more smoothly. The balance between how much rage she gains or loses from triggering events has been reworked to eliminate abrupt spikes.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Nighthollow self-destruct behavior[/b][/h3][p]Previously, after killing a player, Nighthollow would sometimes remain in the scene. To keep gameplay flowing and fair, Nighthollow will now automatically disappear from the scene immediately upon killing someone.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Piano interaction info notification added[/b][/h3][p]When you sit at the piano, a new prompt will appear: “When seated at the piano, you can also use your keyboard keys.” This lets you play using both mouse and keyboard inputs.[/p]

tags.balance_change: Lily’s rage bar now fills and depletes more smoothly. The balance between how much rage she gains or loses from triggering events has been reworked to eliminate abrupt spikes.

tags.bug: Previously, after killing a player, Nighthollow would sometimes remain in the scene. To keep gameplay flowing and fair, Nighthollow will now automatically disappear from the scene immediately upon killing someone.

tags.feature: When you sit at the piano, a new prompt will appear: “When seated at the piano, you can also use your keyboard keys.” This lets you play using both mouse and keyboard inputs.
